crossRefs.note: He said, “You have asked a hard thing. If you see me when I am taken from you, it will be so for you; but if not, it…
This is an easy thing in Yahweh’s sight. He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
Indeed, he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore…
When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”
He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing, except by prayer and fasting.”
Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works…

parallels.note: Behold, I will cause the shadow on the sundial, which has gone down on the sundial of Ahaz with the sun, to return…

translations.web: Hezekiah answered, “It is a light thing for the shadow to go forward ten steps. No, but let the shadow return backward ten steps.”
translations.bsb: “It is easy for the shadow to lengthen ten steps,” answered Hezekiah, “but not for it to go back ten steps.”
translations.kjv: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.
translations.asv: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to decline ten steps: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten steps.
